summary: Examples of regex_replace with numbered and named groups, multiline/ignorecase or inline flags, and count=1 to replace only the first match.
questions: How do I convert 'localhost:80' to 'localhost, 80' with named groups?
How do I comment out matching lines with regex_replace?
How do I replace only the first '=' in a string?

answer_card.title: regex_replace examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
whatami: "{{ 'ansible' | regex_replace('^a.*i(.*)$', 'a\\1') }}"   # 'able'

commalocal: "{{ 'localhost:80' | regex_replace('^(?P<host>.+):(?P<port>\\d+)$', '\\g<host>, \\g<port>') }}"
# 'localhost, 80'

piratecomment: "{{ 'CAR\ntar\nfoo\nbar\n' | regex_replace('^(.ar)$', '#\\1', multiline=True, ignorecase=True) }}"
# or inline flags: regex_replace('(?im)^(.ar)$', '#\\1')

key_value: "{{ 'foo=bar=baz' | regex_replace('=', ':', count=1) }}"   # 'foo:bar=baz'
```
